## Primary Software Engineering Projects

1. OPERON
   - Purpose: Operations platform exploring multi-agent business workflows across Support, Finance, and HR with human-in-the-loop checkpoints for critical decisions.
   - Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, React, Multi-Agent AI Architecture, REST API.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/Operon
   - Live Demo: https://operonpro.vercel.app

2. SayamSolves
   - Purpose: Open-source C++ repository documenting deliberate daily algorithmic problem solving across LeetCode, with time and space complexity notes.
   - Stack: C++, Data Structures, Algorithms, LeetCode.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/sayam-solves

3. MAUSAM
   - Purpose: Weather intelligence and localized climate analytics dashboard built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026) by Team Algnite, unifying forecasts, AQI, UV index, soil moisture, and coastal tides.
   - Stack: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Meteorological APIs, Python.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/mausam
   - Live Demo: https://mausamgovt.vercel.app

4. Interactive Developer Portfolio
   - Purpose: Full-stack developer portfolio and engineering showcase with pre-rendered GitHub activity telemetry, dark/light theme system, and verified credentials archive.
   - Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Express, Vite, Motion.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/Sayam-Mukherjee-Portfolio
   - Live Site: https://sayammukherjee.in

5. YOLO / YOLOv8 Edge Computer Vision
   - Purpose: Edge computer vision pipeline combining lightweight YOLOv8 models with OpenCV frame processing to detect objects and compute spatial motion vectors on local hardware.
   - Stack: Python, YOLOv8, OpenCV, PyTorch, Computer Vision.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam

## Website Architecture & Telemetry Principles

- Pre-Rendered Telemetry: Repository stats and commit metrics are fetched via scheduled GitHub Actions into static JSON (`public/data/github.json`), preventing client-side API rate limits.
- Privacy First: Zero tracking cookies; strictly optional cookieless telemetry; anonymized UTM attribution with user consent.
- Liquid Glass Design: Restrained Apple/iOS-inspired translucent surfaces, keyboard navigation, and responsive typography.
